top_signals.title: Gold Holds Above $4,300 as Traders Weigh Hormuz Talks, Inflation
top_signals.summary: Gold steadied above $4,300 an ounce, as traders assessed the latest development around the Strait of Hormuz while awaiting the release of a key US inflation report later this week.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Trump signals shift to economic pressure as Iran hardens stance over Strait of Hormuz
top_signals.summary: The escalating tally underscores how far the two sides remain from resolving a crisis that has choked the Strait of Hormuz for more than five months.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Investors Abandon Hedges in Order to Chase Soaring Stocks
top_signals.summary: Demand for protection against a drop in stocks has fallen to the lowest level since US President Donald Trump’s capitulation on tariffs last year, as indexes rally to record highs.
